name: propease
description: PropEase - 多租户公寓管理系统

scripts.docker:middleware: docker compose -p propease-middleware -f docker/docker-compose.middleware.yaml --env-file docker/.env.middleware up -d --remove-orphans
scripts.docker:prod: docker compose -p propease-prod -f docker/docker-compose.yaml --env-file docker/.env.production up -d --remove-orphans
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter propease-api run lint && pnpm --filter propease-tenant run lint && pnpm --filter propease-admin run lint
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter propease-api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter propease-api run type-check && pnpm --filter propease-tenant run type-check && pnpm --filter propease-admin run type-check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter propease-api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter propease-api run test && pnpm --filter propease-tenant run test:run && pnpm --filter propease-admin run test:run
